verdict.rationale: Warp is a terminal, so scripting it through a CLI or IPC interface is a fair axis to judge. The documented CLIs (the Oz CLI and the Warp Agent CLI) run and manage AI agents, and the settings file only gives programmatic control over settings. None of the evidence shows a CLI or IPC interface for opening windows or tabs, sending text to sessions, or querying terminal state.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script and control the terminal from the command line — open windows, send text, query state — via a documented CLI or IPC interface
